compiled_state.title: Create design-md fixture files with violation and clean specimens
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Fixture directory exists with at least one violation file per violation class
- dd-2: Contains at least one clean file per scope-eligible file family

## Implementation
Create tests/scripts/fixtures/design-md/ with:
- 10 violation-*.css files (one per violation class: hardcoded-hex, hardcoded-rgb, off-scale-spacing, off-scale-padding, off-scale-margin, off-scale-gap, off-scale-font-size, off-scale-line-height, broken-token-ref, wcag-failing-contrast)
- 8+ clean-baseline.{css,scss,tsx,jsx,vue,svelte,html,ejs} files

Note: Using tests/scripts/fixtures/ (not plugins/dso/tests/) per invariant:no-dev-artifacts-in-plugin.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Fixture directory exists — Verify: test -d tests/scripts/fixtures/design-md/
- [ ] At least 10 violation files — Verify: ls tests/scripts/fixtures/design-md/violation-* | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 < 10)}'
- [ ] At least 8 clean files — Verify: ls tests/scripts/fixtures/design-md/clean-* | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 < 8)}'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
